authorDesc.en: Radif Partners writes the tax engine behind Sole Trader Sums from what HMRC and the Scottish Government publish for 6 April 2026 to 5 April 2027: the Income Tax bands for England, Wales, Northern Ireland and Scotland, Class 2 and Class 4 National Insurance, student loan thresholds, dividend and Corporation Tax rates, and the Making Tax Digital rules for sole traders. Every figure carries the GOV.UK or legislation.gov.uk page it was read on and the date. We sell no accounting, banking or software service and ask for no email.
